s: Hakanat haesh qodem haknasat shabbat ubo d' seipim: asur laasot medura meetzim samuk lachasheka, ella im ken matztzit bahem haur kol kak ad shettehe hashshalhebet ola meeleha beli siyyua etzim acherim, gezera shemma yachteh bah beshabbat veyanid haetzim kede shettaaleh hashshalhebet. Veim hu etz yechidi — tzarik sheyyeechoz haur mibbeod yom berob heqqepo uberob obyo, dehaynu sheyyikkanes haur beobi haetz ad rubbo, umibbachutz yaqqipennu gam ken ad rob heqqepo, sheaz yiddaleq meelayv beshabbat, velo yitztarek kelal lahanido:

Etzim shello hudlequ mibbeod yom keshiur shennitbaer, ap al pi shehudlequ achar kak mealehem beshabbat beinyan sheshshub en lachush shemma yachteh bahem — ap al pi ken asur lehanot mehem beshabbat, kevan shehudlequ mibbeod yom beissur. Abal im hudlequ mibbeod yom keshiur shennitbaer — yakol lehitchammem kenegdam ulehishtammesh leoran, ben shehem al gabbe qarqa, ben shehem al gabbe menora. Vaapillu middebarim sheasur laasot mehem petila lener mippene shehaor mesakseket bahem veenah neechezet bahem yapeh kemo sheyyitbaer besimman rs"d — muttar laasot mehem medura bekol maqom, lepi shebbimdura shehi hesseq gadol mabir haechad et chabero:

Yesh omerim shebbappechamin apillu lo achaz bahem haur ella kol shehu mibbeod yom — hare zeh muttar, lepi shehem doleqim veholekim mealehem. Veyesh choleqin al zeh. Ubedibre soperim — hallek achar hammeqel:

Medura shel zepet veshel goprit veshel qash ugebaba, apillu lo achaz bahen haur ella kol shehu — hare zeh muttar, shehem doleqim veholekim mealehem. Veken medura shel qanim veshel garine temarim keshehem meporadim. Abal im haqqanim hem agudim vehaggarinim hem bassal — tzerikim sheyyatztzit bahem haur kol kak beinyan shettehe hashshalhebet ola meeleha, lepi sheen hashshalhebet yekola likkanes bahem meeleha:
